exposure: pressure in the vaginal birth process
Birth method (Caesarean section or vaginal birth)
cohort: 91 children aged three and four years from various language, cultural, and socioeconomic groups in South Africa
finding: Contrary to the hypothesis, the prevalence of sensory hyperreactivity was higher in the vaginal birth group than the caesarean section group, although the results may be influenced by sociocultural and socioeconomic factors.
mod_finding: The prevalence of sensory hyperreactivity was higher in the vaginal birth group than the caesarean section group.
